verdict.rationale: Paxos is an API platform, so official SDKs are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence covers only REST API v2 endpoints, a FIX API, a WebSocket API, OAuth client-credentials auth, a Sandbox, and llms.txt/llms-full.txt for AI tools, but none of it mentions an official SDK or client library in any language. The OpenAPI spec probe also returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is no published spec that could stand in for an SDK.
